models.name: Meng Yi

This model gains an Activation Counter.

notes.d: While this model has zero Ki Tokens, it has Slow. Only Vermillion Fangshi models can Channel to this model.
This model has Parry (+1), Ranged Defence (+1), and Armour (+1) unless Surprised.

models.traits: Armour (3), Construct, Group, Soulless

feats.d: Friendly Shìbīng models gain an Activation Counter. This Ki Feat may be used while this model is represented by a Terrain Card.

notes.d: While this model has zero Ki Tokens, it has Slow. When this model gains Activation Counters it gains only one rather than two. During the Main Phase, while Exhausted, this model is no longer a model and becomes Inert Warrior Terrain Element. weapons.t: Reach, Powerful Attack (1), Push Attack (0), Sweep Defence (1)

feats.d: Target other Friendly Princess model gains an Activation Marker.

models.name: Yanjing
models.traits: Bodyguard [Princess]:(3"), Bravery, Command [Princess]:(2/6"), Co-ordinated Attack [Princess], Prowess [Melee]:(1), Vengeance [Blood Brother]

feats.d: Target other Friendly Princess model gains an Activation Marker.
Immediately Heal all Friendly Princesses in the Pulse to have the same number of marked Wound boxes as the least Wounded Friendly Princess model.

notes.d: When making a Ranged Attack, Friendly Princess models are never considered to be in BtB with the Target.

models.name: Yizhi
models.traits: Bodyguard [Princess]:(3"), Bravery, Cloudwalk, Command [Princess]:(2/6"), Co-ordinated Attack [Princess], Indomitable (1), Prowess [Melee]:(1), Vengeance [Blood Brother]

feats.d: Target other Friendly Princess model gains an Activation Marker.

During an Enemy model’s activation, when that model moves into BtB with another Friendly Princess model in the Pulse, move this model into BtB with that Enemy model by the shortest route. If it is not possible to put this model in BtB with the Enemy model this feat cannot be used.

notes.d: The Rice Cost for Yizhi, Xi and Yanjing is 36 for all three models.

feats.d: Other Friendly non-Kami, non-Soulless models in the Aura when this Ki Feat is used gain 1 Ki Token. Friendly Imperial models in the Aura gain Bodyguard Imperial .

notes.d: This model wins all tie breaks regardless of the usual rules for Conflict Resolution. If both models have this ability, resolve the tie break normally.

It may be placed in Scenario Zones and within 2" of the edge of the table.

the imperial march.title: The Imperial March
the imperial march.text: After Deployment choose 1 Enemy model to gain a Death Sentence Marker Enemy models cannot spend Ki Tokens to remove Death Sentence Markers Permitted [Imperial Models]

the unfurled wing.title: The Unfurled Wing
the unfurled wing.text: Play during Deployment. For the rest of the game, in the Starting Phase before the Tactical Test, if a Friendly model will Deploy using the Flank Trait that turn choose a Friendly model to gain Tactician (1).

models.name: Fuwa Eagle
models.traits: Cloudwalk, Flank, Group, Insignificant, Immune [Prone], Tiny

notes.d: When this model arives from Elsewhere, if it declares a Charge Action, it does not need LoS to its Target. The Charge Target is Surprised, regardless of the usual Surprised requirements.
This card represents three different models, each with their own abilities. A Warband may not recruit multiples of the same Eagle.
During the Starting Phase, this model's Controller may place this model Elsewhere. This model gains Flank and returns to play using those rules.

models.name: Golden Sentinel
models.traits: Armour (3), Bodyguard [Imperial]:(3"), Fearless, Immune [Control], Prowess [Melee]:(1)

feats.d: This model gains Tough (+1) until the End Phase.

notes.d: This model cannot declare Melee or Charge actions Targeting Imperial models.
While within 3" of another Friendly Imperial model, this model gains Aware and its Melee Weapons gain Reach.

models.name: Taiyo
models.traits: Cowardly

feats.d: Remove a Reload Marker from, or and an Ammo Token to, a model in the Pulse.

notes.d: This model may be Recruited into the following Faction Themes (Guerilla Warfare, Open Rebellion).

models.name: Yu
models.traits: Bravery, Willpower (1), Strategy [+1 Ki Token]

feats.d: Choose a model completely within a Scenario Zone. That model does not count as being in the zone when calculating Zone Control this turn.

When a model declares a Scenario Action, remove an additional Activation Counter for a Simple Action or one fewer Activation Counters if Complex. If the model cannot remove all Activation Counters required, the activation ends without taking effect and the model removes an Activation Counter. This Ki Feat is Opposed Ki when targeting an Enemy model. This is a Trap effect.
When an Enemy model declares an action that would bring it into BtB with this model, move a Friendly Golden Sentinel model within the Pulse into BtB with the Enemy model by the shortest route.

notes.d: When another Friendly Imperial model starts its activation BtB with this model, if the Imperial model declares a Scenario Action, it may Walk before or after the Scenario Action.

imperial censure.title: Imperial Censure
imperial censure.text: Play in the Starting Phase. Choose a non-Animal, non-lnsignificant, non-Soulless Enemy model and remove an Activation Counter from that model. Requirement [Warband containing an Imperial & Teishin model]

the hozumi family.title: The Hozumi Family
the hozumi family.text: Friendly models begin the game with 1 Ki Token. Hozumi, Taiyo and Ryokeen models may always be recruited into this theme. In the Starting Phase you may choose 1 Enemy model to gain the Aloof Trait until the End Phase. In the Starting Phase, choose 1 Friendly, non-Hozumi model. That model gains Coordinated Attack [Hozumi] until the End Phase. Permitted [Hozumi, Taiyo, Ryokeen, Ronin models]

cleansed by balefire.title: Cleansed by Balefire

to ride through jigoku.title: To Ride Through Jigoku
to ride through jigoku.text: Choose a Friendly Faction Samurai model to gain Ranged Defence (4) and Intangible until the end of the current activation.

beyond the plains.title: Beyond the Plains
beyond the plains.text: Opponent deploys the first 6 pieces of Pool Terrain and then deploys any recruited Warband Terrain Elements (these are deployed before your Warband Terrain). You place no Terrain except Terrain Elements Recruited into this Warband. A Warband may only recruit one Curse Event Card.

No Terrain may be deployed within 1" of this Terrain. If using 'Players deploying Terrain', deploy this Terrain before any other Terrain.

When a Friendly model declares a Run Action, it gains 1 Ki Token. You must recruit a Curse card into the Warband. Permitted [Samurai]

glossary.Armour: Reduce the result of Damage Rolls made against this model by X.
glossary.Bleed: Each time this model inflicts wounds through a Melee Exchange or Ranged Attack to a Non-Soulless Enemy model, that model gains X number of Bleed markers with value Y. If a model has multiple sources of bleed traits, it may only use one at any given time.
glossary.Bodyguard: If an Enemy model declares an action that would move it into BtB with a [Descriptor] Friendly model, or Targets the [Descriptor] Friendly model with a Ranged Attack, this model may switch positions with the Friendly model before the action begins if the following conditions are met: The Friendly model is within X” and in LoS. The Friendly model was not in BtB with an Enemy model at the start of the activation. This model is not in BtB with an Enemy model. This model is not Exhausted or Prone. If the Enemy model has Fear, the bodyguard must pass a fear test. Both models switching positions can fit within the space the other model occupied on the table without moving any other models. If bodyguarding a larger based model, your opponent places the bodyguard anywhere within the area covered by the larger base then you choose facing. The Enemy model’s action is then resolved with this model being declared as the Target. If this model has the Fear trait, the enemy model must make a Fear Test as if this model were its original target. Once the use of the Bodyguard trait by this model is declared, if this model has a Disguised Marker, remove the Disguised Marker immediately.
glossary.Bravery: This model may re-roll a failed Fear Test. It may only re-roll the same Fear Test once due to this trait. If a model with Bravery gains the Cowardly trait, it is considered to have neither trait. If a model with the Bravery trait makes a Fear test against a model with the Terror trait, the effects of both are cancelled.
glossary.Brutal: In a Melee Exchange this model adds X to the result when calculating its final Attack result. This model adds X to the result when calculating its final Ranged Attack result.
glossary.Cloudwalk: When this model moves it ignores Terrain elements, other models, and Zones of Control. It may end its move in an enemy ZoC. This does not allow a model to move out of Melee unless it also has the Agile trait. This model may not end its move occupying the same area as an Impassable Terrain element or another model.
glossary.Co-ordinated Attack: If this model is in a Melee Exchange and one or more Friendly [Descriptor] models is also in BtB with the Enemy model, this model gains +1 Melee Pool bonus.
glossary.Combo Attack: If the Attack is successful then after resolving a Damage Roll, deduct 2 from the Success Level of the Attack. If the new Success Level is 0 or greater make another Damage Roll against the Defender. Repeat this process until the Success Level is less than 0. If the Success Level of the original attack was 0 or 1, after resolving a Damage Roll, make one additional Damage Roll against the Defender at Success Level 0.
glossary.Command: This model may declare a Simple action, Command: The model nominates and activates up to X other non-Exhausted, Friendly [Descriptor] models within Y inches. These models each perform a Standard, Simple action. The order the models activate in is chosen by this model’s Controller after each action is resolved remove an activation counter from the activating model. If a model with the Group trait is chosen you must choose all models on that profile card; if you cannot, then you cannot command any of those models. These are Nested Activations.
glossary.Construct: This model provides cover as if it were terrain.
glossary.Counterstrike Defence: If this Defence is successful, and the Attacker allocated any dice to Attack, then deduct 2 from the Success Level of the Defence. If the Success Level is 0 or greater, then make a Damage Roll against the Attacker using the modified Success Level of the Defence.
glossary.Durable: When this model would suffer more than one wound, it only suffers one wound. This trait is resolved after the Tough trait.
glossary.Endurance: This model suffers no Melee penalty for being Exhausted.
glossary.Fearless: This model automatically succeeds when taking Fear tests and has Immune [Frightened].
glossary.Feint: During Melee Exchanges this model may pick up to X Defence dice rolled by its Opponent to be re- rolled. The same dice may only be re- rolled once due to this model’s trait.
glossary.Forceback Attack: If the Attack is successful, move the Defender 1” directly away from the Attacker, then move the Attacker 1” directly towards the Defender. The Defender suffers half the wounds from the Damage Roll caused by this Attack.
glossary.Group: All models represented by this profile card activate in the same single activation. Each model on this profile card resolves any movement before any Melee Exchanges are resolved. Melee Exchanges are then resolved in the order the Controlling player chooses. These are Nested Activations.
glossary.Immovable: This model may not be Moved or Placed except when making a Disengage, Melee, Run, Walk, or Charge or by using a rule on a Friendly card. This model cannot gain Prone Markers. This model does not rotate at the start of a Melee Exchange, or when performing a Scenario Action.
glossary.Immune: This model may not gain markers of [Descriptor]. If a model gains the Immune trait, immediately remove all markers of [Descriptor].
glossary.Impenetrable Defence: During this model’s Melee Exchanges the Enemy model must remove its highest Attack die rolled before the final Attack result is calculated.
glossary.Indomitable: This model ignores X assisting Enemy models in BtB for penalties during Melee Exchanges.
glossary.Intimidate: During the Starting Phase, this model can Target an enemy model within 8”, Perform an Opposed Ki test with the Targeted model, if this model is successful the Target gains Cowardly, loses Aggressive and cannot Choose or Target this model with a Melee, Charge or Ranged Attack until the End Phase.
glossary.Parry: This model adds X to the Defence result when calculating its final Defence result in Melee Exchanges.
glossary.Pierce: When this model succeeds with an Attack using this weapon, reduce the Enemy model’s Armour trait by X to a minimum of 0.
glossary.Powerful Attack: If the Attack is successful, then the Attacker gains +3 to the Damage Roll caused by this Attack.
glossary.Prowess: During a [Descriptor] Test this model may re- roll up to X of its own dice. It may only re-roll dice once due to this trait. The Descriptors [Attack] and [Defence] refer to Melee Exchanges but are further limited.
glossary.Push Attack: If the Attack is successful, move the Defender directly away from this model until it leaves this model’s ZoC. The Defender does not suffer a Damage Roll from this Attack.
glossary.Push Defence: If the Defence is successful, move the Attacker directly away from the Defender until it leaves the defender’s ZoC.
glossary.Ranged Defence: A model making a Ranged Attack against this model modifies the Challenge Number of the test by X.
glossary.Reach: While using this weapon, it grants this model the Initiative at Step 3 of a Melee Exchange, provided it was not in BtB with its opponent or another Enemy model at the start of the current Activation. If both models in a Melee Exchange would benefit from this Trait, then neither benefits from it.
glossary.Reload: When this model makes a Ranged Attack with this weapon it gains X Reload Markers.
glossary.Sidestep Defence: If the Defence is successful, the Defender leaves BtB and then moves away from the Attacker until the Defender leaves The Attacker's ZoC, at which point its movement ends.
glossary.Slow: This model may not declare Run or Charge actions. During a melee exchange, this model will lose the initiative if it is the active model. If this model has Lightning Reflexes, a weapon with the Reach trait or both then it ignores those traits and Slow for the duration of the melee exchange.
glossary.Soulless: This model automatically succeeds at Fear tests and has Immune [Bleed, Frightened, Poison]. This model also automatically succeeds at Opposed Ki Tests when it is not the Active model.
glossary.Sweep Defence: If the Defence is successful, then the Attacker becomes Prone.
glossary.Vengeance: This model’s melee weapons gain Brutal (+1) and +1 Melee Strength when resolving a melee exchange against a [Descriptor] Model.
glossary.Aloof: This model may not perform Scenario Actions.
glossary.Aware: This model’s LoS extends 360 degrees around its base.
glossary.Cowardly: This model must re-roll successful Fear tests. It must only re- roll the same Fear test once due to this trait. If a model with Cowardly gains the Bravery trait it is considered to have neither trait.
glossary.Flank: When this model would be Deployed, this model’s Controller must choose whether this model will use Flank or not. If the player chooses not to use Flank, this model is Deployed as normal. If the player decides the model is using Flank, then the model is left Elsewhere and instead before the game the owning player makes a note of which turn the Flanking models will arrive and notes a neutral table edge. This is Hidden Information. This must be turn 2, 3, or 4. In the Starting Phase of that turn reveal the number and deploy the models anywhere along the chosen edge but not in the Opponent’s Deployment Zone. If a model gains Flank mid game or is removed and returns to play using the Flank rules, you immediately note any turn after the current turn (not just 2, 3, or 4) and a neutral edge for that model when it is removed from play. This is Hidden Information. Flanking models generate two Activation Counters when they are Deployed.
glossary.Insignificant: This model: Has a ZoC that may be ignored at all times. Cannot apply Melee assist Modifiers. May not perform Simple Scenario or Complex Scenario actions.
glossary.Sharp: This model reduces the enemy model’s Tough trait by X, to a minimum of 0, when it succeeds with an Attack with this weapon.
glossary.Sidestep Attack: If the Attack is successful, the Attacker leaves BtB and then moves away from the Defender until the Attacker leaves The Defender's ZoC, at which point its movement ends. The Attacker makes no damage roll.
glossary.Strategy: Whenever you win the Tactical Roll, this model gains the bracketed bonus.
glossary.Tactician: This model adds X dice when it performs Tactical Tests.
glossary.Tiny: This model is Tiny sized. Models Targeting this model with a Ranged Attack add a +1 modifier to the Challenge Number of the test. This model rolls one die for Size Tests.
glossary.Tough: When this model would suffer Wounds from any source reduce the final number of Wounds by X (If X is negative, instead you will increase the number of wounds taken).
glossary.Willpower: This model modifies the result by X when calculating its final result in Opposed Ki tests when it is the Activating model.
glossary.Charging Bonus: When this model makes a Charge action it gains the bracketed Bonus until the end of its current activation. If the bonus is a Weapon Trait, then it applies to all valid weapons. This trait may also be a weapon trait if so the bonus only applies when choosing this weapon.
glossary.Courage: When making a Fear Test, modify the result by X.
glossary.Dread: Models making a fear test against this model reduce their Ki statistic by X. This cannot reduce the number of dice rolled below 1 die. Enemy models with Fear values equal to or higher than this model’s fear value do not automatically pass their fear tests against this model.
glossary.Fear: When a model makes a Fear test against this model X is the Challenge Number for the test. Models automatically pass Fear tests with a Challenge Number equal to or lower than their Fear (X) trait, but must still take a Fear test if the Challenge Number is higher than their Fear (X) trait.
glossary.Intangible: This model ignores Zones of Control, other models and Terrain elements during movement and being in BtB when declaring actions; it may move out of BtB freely. It may not end its move occupying the same area as an Impassable Terrain element or another model. This model also has Immune [Held, Immobilised].
glossary.Lightweight: This model does not suffer the modifier for moving during a Ranged Attack when using this weapon.
glossary.Resistance: This model modifies the result by X when it participates in an Opposed Ki test and is not the Activating model.
glossary.Terror: If a model makes a Fear test caused by this model it must re-roll the test if it succeeds. Models must only re-roll the same test once due to this trait. If a model with the Bravery trait makes a Fear test caused by this model the effects of both traits are cancelled.
